newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy repeated for ADM, Tyson, others.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy repeated for ADM, Tyson, others.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch analyst Leonard Teitelbaum said Friday he reiterated his buy ratings on Archer Daniels Midland Co, ConAgra Inc, Tyson Foods Inc and Hudson Foods Inc due to expected lower costs.

-- Poultry producers Tyson and Hudson will see a direct benefit from expected lower grain and feed costs. ConAgra likely will reap savings in its poultry, cattle feeding and edible oils businesses, he added.
-- ADM, a grain processor that makes high fructose corn syrup and other products, likely will see better margins in the current fiscal year, Teitelbaum said.
-- ConAgra shares were off 1/8 at 61. Hudson Foods rose 1/8 at 15-3/4. ADM was unchanged at 19-5/8. Tyson rose 1/8 at 18-7/8.
